lore.Noctis City: Ekujuleni kwe-Noctis Labyrinthus, bevikelwe emisebeni yomkhathi yizindonga zomhosha eziphakeme ngekhilomitha, abahlali bokuqala bathola indawo efanelekile yedolobha.
lore.Tharsis Tholus: Intaba-mlilo endala emise okwesihlangu enesiqongo esiwile. Imihubhe yayo yodaka lwentaba-mlilo yayiyizindawo zokuqala zokukhosela zamathimba okuhlola e-Tharsis, futhi isabhonga ngamafeni okungenisa umoya.
lore.Ascraeus Mons: Esenyakatho kakhulu kulezi zingxinga ezintathu ze-Tharsis, ephakeme ngo-km 18. Esigodini sayo esiqongweni kulapho kwahlolwa khona ikheshi lokuqala lokuya ku-orbit kwase kushiywa.
lore.Pavonis Mons: Ihlezi cishe ngqo enkabazwe, "Intaba Yepikoko" iyihange lemvelo lekheshi lomkhathi; izibani zokuhlola eceleni kwayo zisacwayiza.
lore.Arsia Mons: Intaba-mlilo eseningizimu ye-Tharsis, embozwe amafu asekuseni. Isigodi sayo sigcina iqhwa elidala kunawo wonke esifundeni, ekubangwe ngalo kusukela kumqulu wokuqala wamalungelo amanzi.
lore.Ganymede Colony: Inyanga enkulu kunazo zonke ka-Jupiter, inkulu kuno-Mercury. Ikoloni lihlezi emhlabathini okhanyayo onemisele, lihwebelana ngeqhwa lamanzi nokubekezela nesistimu yangaphakathi.
lore.Phobos Space Haven: Inyanga yangaphakathi ye-Mars, ehamba ngo-km 6,000 ngaphezu komhlabathi. Umgodi wayo i-Stickney owambiwa waba yichweba elimatasa kakhulu phakathi kwe-Mars nebhande lama-asteroyidi.
lore.Elysium Mons: Intaba-mlilo enkulu yasempumalanga, ephakeme ngo-km 12 futhi ethule iminyaka eyizigidi ezimbalwa. Abahloli bafunga ukuthi isiqongo sifudumele kunalokho okufanele; inhlangano yamandla okushisa komhlaba iyenqaba ngenhlonipho ukuphawula.
lore.Hecates Tholus: Iqanjwe ngonkulunkulukazi wezimpambano zemigwaqo nobusuku. Izinhlangothi zayo zibazwe yizinguzunga zeqhwa zasendulo, futhi abavukuzi beqhwa abasebenza lapho bashiya isibani sivutha onqenqemeni lwesigodi ukuze bathole inhlanhla.
lore.Olympus Mons: Intaba-mlilo ende kunazo zonke esistimini yelanga: iphakeme ngo-km 22 futhi ibanzi njenge-France. Usesiqongweni umkhathizwe ukude kangangokuthi awukwazi nokubona ukuthi usentabeni. Ukubuka kusakufanele ukuhamba kwamasonto amathathu.
lore.South Pole: Ungqimba phezu kongqimba lweqhwa lamanzi ngaphansi kwekhephu lesizini leqhwa elomile. Intwasahlobo ngayinye i-CO₂ iba ngumusi emithonjeni emnyama abantu bakhona abayibiza ngokuthi "izicabucabu" futhi izivakashi zikhokha imali enhle ukuze ziyibone.
lore.Alba Mons: Intaba-mlilo ebanzi kunazo zonke ku-Mars, eyelula ngaphezu kuka-km 1,000 kodwa ephakeme ngo-km 7 kuphela. Intaba ongayikhwela ungaqaphelanga, into i-Alba Hill-Walkers’ Society eyibheka njengento ekhethekile.
lore.Uranius Tholus: Intaba-mlilo encane ewumqansa ehlezi emthunzini kamfowabo omkhulu i-Uranius Mons. Isiteshi sokuqala sesimo sezulu esizenzakalelayo emathafeni asenyakatho sabhawulwa esiqongweni sayo futhi sisathumela isibikezelo njalo ngehora: uthuli.
lore.Viking 1: Indawo lapho kwehlela khona i-Viking 1, umkhumbi wokuqala owasebenza phezu kwe-Mars (1976). Umkhumbi uzungezwe ngothango njengendawo yamagugu, futhi umhlali omusha ngamunye kulindeleke ukuthi ashiye itshana elilodwa esangweni.
lore.Viking 2: Lapho i-Viking 2 yehlela khona e-Utopia Planitia ngo-1976 futhi yathatha isithombe seqhwa phezu kwamatshe. Indawo yokuhlala yakhula izungeze umkhumbi, futhi iqhwa manje ligujwa njalo ebusika ngomkhosi wesobho elibanda kakhulu.
lore.North Pole: Ikhephu leqhwa lamanzi elicishe libe ngu-km 3 ukujiya, elinemihosha ejikelezayo ebazwe ngumoya. Onjiniyela bolwandle balibiza ngokuthi "idamu", futhi basho ngempela.

menu.autoTitle: Vumela i-TFMBot yenze isinqumo sakho samanje
menu.fine: Injini yemithetho: tfmc (C → WebAssembly) kusiphequluli sakho. TFMBot: umpetha osetshenziswayo, esebenza ngqo kuseva. Ayihlangene ne-FryxGames, i-Asmodee Digital noma i-Steam.
help.title: Indlela yokudlala lapha
help.globe:
Imbulunga
Hudula ukuze ujikeleze · isondo / ukuncinza ukuze usondeze · iminwe emibili noma ukuhudula ngakwesokudla ukuze uhambise · chofoza kabili (noma u-H) ukuze ubuyele phakathi.
help.turn:
Ithuba lakho
Amakhadi akhanyayo esandleni sakho ayadlaleka — chofoza elilodwa ukuze ulifunde futhi ulidlale. Amaphrojekthi ajwayelekile, izenzo zamakhadi, izinqophamlando nemiklomelo kungakwesokudla.
help.tiles:
Ukubeka amathayela
Izindawo ezingakhethwa zikhanya ngegolide. Hambisa phezu kwazo ukuze ubone ithayela kusengaphambili nalokho indawo ekunikeza kona.
help.undo:
Hlehlisa
Hlehlisa noma yini kuze kuvezwe ikhadi. Uma ithuba lakho liphela uthola Qinisekisa ithuba — akukho okufika ku-TFMBot uze uqinisekise. Ctrl+Z hlehlisa · Enter qinisekisa · Esc khansela.
help.opp:
Umphikisi
Hambisa phezulu (noma ubambe) ibhodi lomdlali ukuze ubone amakhadi akhe etafula. Uhlu olungakwesobunxele lubonisa ukunyakaza ngakunye kwe-TFMBot nokunye ekucubungulile; ibha engaphezulu ibonisa isilinganiso sayo sethuba lakho lokuwina.
help.tracks:
Izilinganiso
Izinga lokushisa: amabhonasi okukhiqiza ukushisa ku-−24 no-−20, ulwandle ku-0 °C. I-oksijini: +1 izinga lokushisa ku-8%. Izilwandle: izindawo ezingu-9.
help.hint:
💡 Ithiphu
Ibuza i-TFMBot ukuthi ibingadlalani esikhundleni sakho, kanye nengxenye yokusesha yezinketho zayo ezinhle kakhulu.
